instruction: Based on the question I posted about my last t-shirt order on amazon, has anyone experienced color fading after the first wash? Say yes or no.
notes: Fixed the parse error: the predicate formerly named `supervisor` clashed with the `supervisor` app constant; it is now `is-supervisor`, and only `amazon` is declared as an app constant since no predicate references the supervisor app. Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so every modeled action is a lookup. World structure (which order is the last t-shirt order, which product it contains, which question the supervisor posted) is encoded as static init facts; knowledge predicates (known-id, verified-tshirt, found-answer) are asserted by lookup actions so the planner must go show_orders -> show_order -> show_product -> show_product_questions -> show_product_question_answers before complete_task. show_product confirms the ordered product is actually a t-shirt. The yes/no answer object is a runtime value read from the answers; supervisor.complete_task passes it as `answer`, requires every goal condition, and is the only action producing (task-completed), while every other action requires (not (task-completed)).
